voice.tagline: Shop it! Love it! Keep it!

about.title: The things a house runs on, in one basket.
about.lede: A small UK shop with a very large cupboard. Everyday things for the home, the bathroom and looking after yourself, chosen with care.

sections.heading: Why one shop
sections.text: A house needs many kinds of thing. A bathroom scale, a make-up mirror, a massager and a dressing gown usually mean four orders and four delivery charges. Here they go in one basket, with one delivery charge.

sections.heading: How we choose what we stock
sections.text:
Much of the range we already sell elsewhere, so we know it and how it arrives.

If you cannot find something, tell us what it is and we will look for it.

refusals.no: Ask you to create an account.
refusals.why: You check out with your email and address, and that is all.

refusals.no: Put a countdown timer on a product.
refusals.why: If stock is low the page says so. If it is not, it does not.
A crossed-out price is one we genuinely charged before.
We use them to send your order and to answer you, and for nothing else.

closing.heading: If something goes wrong
closing.text: Write to us and a person replies. Send your order reference and what has happened, and we will put it right. Your rights under UK law are set out in full on the returns page.
